title: What makes a robot?
about: Sense, Think, Act: the three things every robot does.

html: A robot is a machine that can Sense, Think, and Act, all on its own.
SenseNotice the world with sensors, like a camera or a touch sensor.
ThinkA computer decides what to do, like a Raspberry Pi.
ActDo something: drive wheels, move an arm, fire thrusters.
• Sense: bump sensors feel walls, and cliff sensors notice stairs.
• Think: its computer decides where to go next.
If a machine is missing one of these, or a person has to make every decision, it isn't a robot.

steps.q: A robot's computer (like the Raspberry Pi on our robot arm) is which part?
steps.explain: The computer makes the decisions. That's the Think part.

steps.q: The robot arm's camera spots a red block. Which part is that?
steps.explain: Seeing the block is sensing. Then the computer thinks, and the servos act.
